name: Steve Lewis
summary: Steve Lewis is an American attorney and politician who served as the 38th Speaker of the Oklahoma House of Representatives from 1989 to 1991. He also served as the U.S. Attorney for the Northern District of Oklahoma from 1993 to 2000, the 27th district of the Oklahoma House representative from 1980 to 1990, and as the district attorney for Pottawatomie and Lincoln Counties from 1971 to 1979.
